finding: A destination-exists check followed by Windows std::fs::rename left a time-of-check/time-of-use race: a competing writer could create the destination after the check and be overwritten by rename. Source-level correctness/security finding, not a CVE or known user-file incident.
change: Use same-directory MoveFileExW with MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH and without REPLACE_EXISTING or COPY_ALLOWED. No replacing fallback. Existing parent is canonicalized for stable extended-length Windows paths. Incomplete/length-changed or unsynced partials are never published; only the invocation's private partial is cleaned on failure. Existing destination bytes are preserved.

cases: primitive refuses existing destination without altering either file
late collision preserves competing complete file and removes own partial
two concurrent finalizers publish exactly one complete copy
incomplete and changed-length transfers refuse publication
Unicode and extended-length Windows paths save and reopen
verification.limits: Same-host native filesystem and installed WebView2 tests, not all network/removable filesystems, clean-machine, disconnected-network or complete security certification. The overwrite race itself is covered deterministically by native collision/concurrent-finalizer tests.

dependencyChange: Enable Win32_Storage_FileSystem on existing pinned windows-sys 0.61.2; no new crate, version, filesystem permission or paid service.
